reasoning: In mid-March in Reims, France, temperatures are generally rising as spring approaches. March 22 is one week after March 15, so climatologically we'd expect slightly warmer temperatures on average. However, day-to-day weather variability is substantial and can easily override the small seasonal trend (~0.2-0.3°C per week). Given the high daily variance in temperature, the probability that March 22 is warmer than March 15 is only slightly above 50%, perhaps around 52-55%, accounting for the modest seasonal warming trend.
